as_told.title: NewsNation slide: DOE advanced gravity propulsion research, Havana syndrome victim

plain: A slide shown by NewsNation, a US television news channel that Michels says covers UFOs a lot, is said to tie a patient to "advanced gravity propulsion research" at the Department of Energy, the US government department that runs much of the country's nuclear and energy research. According to Michels, the patient had damage to the brain's white matter, the kind of bodily harm he compares to Havana syndrome, the name given to mysterious injuries reported by US officials. Michels describes the slide himself in two episodes, in 2024 and 2026, the first time while discussing the journalist Ross Coulthart and the researcher Eric Weinstein, as a hint that such research could hurt the people near it.
